title: From Pixels to Tokens: A Systematic Study of Latent Action Supervision for Vision-Language-Action Models

layout.note: Two dashed panels side by side: a narrow left panel for the framework (two cards above a VLM box above three input icons) and a wide right panel with two stacked numbered perspectives; the left part of each draws the latent-action machinery and the right edge holds the four strategy schematics in one column.

lesson: Fix the shared framework in a left panel and stack the variants as aligned rows that share the same input box in a right panel; give each module one colour that never changes so only the changing target stands out, and group the rows under numbered perspective headings whose key terms are coloured like the boxes.
